required_corrections_to_master_spec: Internal economic truth should live behind a dedicated non-exposed API boundary in addition to RLS and least-privilege grants.
Stripe webhook handlers must be idempotent and order-independent and use upsert/state reconciliation rather than assuming event order.
Godot peers executing the same script must have identical @rpc signatures; gameplay actions must remain server-authoritative and must not use any_peer as a gameplay authority shortcut.
